This is sand leveling, or topdressing. It creates a more level surface for your lawn by filling in low areas. I use masonry sand since I have Bermuda grass. If you have a cool season grass type, a screened topsoil may be better. I like to put a little fertilizer down prior to, and after to ensure bermuda is growing aggressively through the sand. Hydroseeding is the future of grass planting and @liquidgreenhydroseeding is pioneering the industry. 21 hours in 90 seconds👨🏽‍🌾 ⚠️Flash Warning⚠️ This house was bought near the end of 2025 and the garden was a right state!  I was called in to replace the fence panels and totally rip out the garden  (not the posts, they are a bit crooked but they are still standing😅)  I started with the fence panels, then began to totally clear the area of weeds and any other debris in the garden.  We added 2 railway sleepers at the back for a little flower bed. Then a thick layer of top soil was spread and we rolled out the turf. Then we moved 4 tonnes of hardcore to the back through the house!  Backbreaking stuff.  Thanks to my pal @Wagwarn Abel for jumping on and giving me a hand 🙏 This is obviously unfinished but I think the owner was going to slab the rest himself, so our job is done here for now! As always I wanna know what would YOU do now? There's a bed at the back that's totally empty!  I read and appreciate any comments and genuinely like reading your suggestions🙏 Thanks so much for watching anyway, follow if you haven't already for more vids like this!! Love, Tom Butler  #satisfying #timelapse #landscaping #gardening

Ornamental grasses do particularly well in the Northeast because many varieties are naturally adapted to cold winters, seasonal changes, and a wide range of soil conditions. Their deep, extensive root systems help them tolerate periods of summer heat and drought once established, while their dormant crowns allow them to survive freezing temperatures and return reliably each spring. Many grasses also thrive in the Northeast’s full sun and well-drained soils and require relatively little maintenance compared with many flowering plants. Their ability to handle both the cold winters and humid summers makes them a dependable choice for Northeast landscapes, while their movement, texture, and winter interest add structure to the landscape year-round.#Westchester#westchestercounty #planting #landscapedesign #Greenwich
